outcome: New Lab versions are now checked in a real browser before they are published
owner_impact: Nothing changes in how the Lab looks or behaves. Behind the scenes, every new version is first opened privately in a real browser on GitHub's machine and must pass the same 8 product checks as the live Lab before it is published, so a broken version no longer reaches students first. A release that is being published is no longer cancelled halfway by a newer change, changes to the release machinery itself are now tested, and agents have one tool that follows their exact version and always ends with one clear answer (green, red with the failing step, replaced by a newer version, documentation only, no run started, or timed out). 'Done means verified live' is unchanged.

next.text: Next is #535, proposal-first merging: every change will reach the live Lab only through a proposal (pull request) whose checks are green. It needs one GitHub setting from you, and I will prepare exact click-by-click steps. #535 has not started.

technical_evidence: CI build job runs the active product smoke against the exact web/dist package served under /virtual-lab/ before Pages upload, on pushes and pull requests; build timeout raised from 15 to 25 minutes.
Concurrency: cancel-in-progress only for pull requests; '.github/workflows/**' removed from paths-ignore.
